summary: __stdcall helper converting three Euler angles (a2, a3, a4) into a quaternion written as (x, y, z, w) to the caller-supplied float pointer a1 (a1[0..3]). It halves each angle, computes the sine/cosine of each half-angle, and combines the products into the four quaternion components using the standard cross-term composition. Returns a1.

operations.description: Halve the a4 angle (v9 = a4 * 0.5) and compute v14 = cos(v9), v17 = sin(v9).
Halve the a3 angle (v15 = a3 * 0.5) and compute v12 = cos(v15), v10 = sin(v15).
Halve the a2 angle (v16 = a2 * 0.5) and compute v13 = cos(v16), v11 = sin(v16).
Write quaternion x to this+0x0: v14 * v6 + v5 * v17 where v5 = v11 * v12 and v6 = v13 * v10.
Write quaternion y to this+0x4: v5 * v14 - v6 * v17.
Write quaternion z to this+0x8: v7 * v17 - v8 * v14 where v7 = v13 * v12 and v8 = v11 * v10.
Write quaternion w to this+0xC: v8 * v17 + v7 * v14.
Return the output quaternion base pointer a1.
